description: The bar chart illustrates the percentage point difference in performance between multilingual BERT (mBERT) and XLM-R models across various layers. The horizontal axis represents the layers, ranging from 0 to 12, with an additional 'concat' category. The vertical axis indicates the percentage point difference, ranging from -10 to 0. The bars are grouped by layer, with each bar representing the difference in performance between mBERT and XLM-R for that specific layer. The bars are uniformly colored in blue, and the values are not explicitly labeled, so exact values cannot be provided. The chart does not include any visual emphasis such as shading or bolding on any of the bars.
